info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Retail Orders Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Status API provides a streamlined way to inquire about the current status of retail orders. By utilizing this endpoint, businesses can access real-time information regarding order fulfillment, shipment tracking, and delivery updates. This API is particularly beneficial for retailers and supply chain managers who need to maintain visibility over their order lifecycle. Typical use cases include monitoring the status of customer orders and integrating order status updates into customer service applications.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of an order.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to check the current status of a specific order. It provides real-time information regarding the processing, shipping, and delivery phases of the order lifecycle.
